senses.gloss:
dual only. mf. (-द्वौ) n. (-द्वे)
Two.
m. (-द्विः)
Two, (of times, &c.) it is only used in composition, as अतिद्वि a thing more than two, and inflected like other nouns in इः in composition with other numerals, it is changed to द्वा, as द्वादश twelve, द्वाविंशति twenty-two, द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A crow.
2 The ruddy goose.
E.
द्वि two, and क the letter क, as in काक.
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Two.
2 Twice.
3 Two-fold.
E.
द्वि two, कन् pleonastick aff.

m. (-रः)
A crow.
E.
द्वि two or twice, and ककार the letter क, as in काक.

m. (-दः^1)
A camel.
E.
द्वि two, and ककुद् a hump.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321. note: kakud and kakudaH are both endings.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what makes two of any thing.
E.
द्वि and कृ to make, ञच् aff.

m. (-गुः)
A form of grammatical combination, that in which the first member of the compound is a numeral.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Twice, two times.
2 Multiplied by two, doubled.
E.
द्वि two, and गुण number.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Twice ploughed.
E.
द्विगुणा twice, and कृत ploughed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Doubled, multiplied by two.
2 Folded, double.
3 Invested, enveloped.
E.
द्वि, and गुण a time, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Doubled.
2 Increased.
E.
द्विगुण twice, कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Doubled.
2 Augmented.
E.
द्विगुण twice, भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Twice born.
2 Oviparous.
m. (-जः)
1 A man of either of the three first classes, a Brahman, a [] Kṣatriya or a Vaiśya whose investiture with the characteristick string, at years of puberty, constitutes, religiously and metaphorically, their second birth.
2 Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, a fish, &c. first born in the shell, and in the second instance produced from it.
3 A tooth.
4 Coriander seed.
f. (-जा)
1 A sort of perfume; also called Reṇukā.
2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indicus.)
3 Kundur or gum olibanum.
E.
द्वि two, and ज born.

m. (-तः)
A tree, (Cordia myxa.)
E.
द्विज a bird, कुत्सित reviled, disregarded.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
1 Twice born, regenerate.
2 Oviparous.
m. (-न्मा)
1 A tooth.
2 A Brahman.
3 A bird.
4 A man of the three first classes.
5 Any oviparous animal: see द्विज.
E.
द्वि twice, जन्मन् birth.

m. (-सः)
A Śūdra or man of the fourth and servile tribe.
E.
द्विज a man of either of the three first castes, and दास a slave.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
द्विज a Brahman, and पति master.

f. (-पा)
A trough near a well for watering birds, cattle, &c.
E.
द्विज a bird, &c. and प्र prefixed to पा to drink, affix अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Acceptable or friendly to a man of the three first classes, or a Brahman especially.
f. (-या)
The moonplant, (Asclepias acida.)
E.
द्विज a Brahman, and प्रिय beloved, the acid juice being drank at certain sacrifices.

m. (-जः)
1 The moon.
2 The great serpent ANANTA.
3 The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
4 Camphor.
E.
द्विज a snake or bird, and राज king.

m. (-ङ्गी)
1 A Kṣatriya or man of the military tribe.
2 An impostor, a pretended Brahman, wearing the distinguishing mark of that tribe without belonging to it.
E.
द्विज twice born, and लिङ्ग a mark, इनि aff.

m. (-र्य्यः)
An excellent or superior Brahman.
E.
द्विज, and वर्य्य excellent.

m. (-णः)
Gumboil, toothache.
E.
द्विज a tooth, व्रण a sore.

m. (-वः)
A Brahman by birth only, one not studied or not practising the duties of his caste.
E.
द्विज a Brahman, and व्रुव who speaks.

m. (-प्तः)
A sort of pulse; also called Raja-māṣ-kalai and Berbetti, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
द्विज a Brahman, and शप्त cursed; it is prohibited food on some occasions.

f. (-षा)
Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahmans, by the fourth.
E.
द्विज, and शुश्रूषा service.

m. (-मः)
A respectable Brahman.
E.
द्विज, and सत्तम best; also द्विजवर, द्विजप्रवर, &c.

m. (-कः)
A Śūdra or man of the fourth and servile class.
E.
द्विज a man of the three first classes, and सेवक a servant.

f. (-वा)
Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahman by the fourth.
E.
द्विज, and सेवा service.

m. (-ज्यः)
A chief or respectable Brahman.
E.
द्विज, and अग्र्य first.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A medicinal plant; also कटुरोहिणी.

(-तिः)
1 A Brahman.
2 A man of either of the three first classes.
3 Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, &c.
E.
द्वि two, जाति birth.

n. (-मं)
The regular order or series of the three first classes.
E.
द्विज, and अनुलोम with the hair.

f. (-नी)
The characteristick thread or cord which designates the three first classes of the Hindūs.
E.
द्विज twiceborn, फक् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-यः)
1 The hollow of a tree.
2 The residence of Brahmans.
E.
द्विज a bird, a Brahman, and आलय an asylum.

mfn. (ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं)
Double-tongued, (literally or figuratively.)
m. (-ह्वः)
1 A snake.
2 An informer.
3 A rogue, a scoundrel, a bad man.
4 A thief.
E.
द्वि two, जिह्वा the tongue.

f. (-ता)
Insincerity, dishonesty.
E.
तल् added to the last.

m. (-मः)
1 A Brahman.
2 A superior or excellent Brahman.
E.
द्विज the twice-born, (three first classes,) and उत्तम best.

f. (-ज्या)
The sine or chord of an arc.
E.
द्वि, and ज्या sine.

n. (-र्गं)
A horizontal line.
E.
द्विज्य, and मार्ग road.

f. (-वा)
Treachery.
E.
द्विष् a foe, सेवा service.

n. (वी)
A traitor.
E.
द्विट् an enemy, and सेविन् who serves.

m. (-ठः)
Svāhā, the expression used with an oblation to fire.

n. (-यं)
A couple, a pair, two.
E.
द्वि two, तयप् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Second.
2 Two.
m. (-यः)
A son, a second or successor.
f. (-या)
1 A wife, according to the ritual, a woman wedded after the ceremony prescribed by the Vedas, a second self as it were.
2 The second day of the fortnight.
E.
द्वि two, and तीय affix, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, द्वितीयक.

n. (-त्वं)
The circumstance or state of second.
E.
द्वितीय, and त्व affix: also with तल्, द्वितीयता.

f. (-ला)
A set of three fruits, the grape, the date, and the Gambhāri.
E.
द्वितीय second, त्रिफल three fruits.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Twice ploughed, &c. (a field.)
E.
द्वितीय a second time, and आकृत made.

f. (-भा)
A scitamineous plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhiza.)
E.
द्वितीय second, आभा lustre.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Second.
E.
द्वितीय, and ईकक pleonasm added.

mfn. plu. always (-त्रः-त्राः-त्रणि)
Two or three.
E.
द्वि two, and त्र for त्रि three.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Two-toothed.
E.
द्वि two, दत् for दन्त a tooth; if marking age or period the compound is द्विदन्त.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
Old enough to have two teeth, &c.
E.
द्वि and दन्त a tooth, see the last.

ind.
Single stick, quarter staff, as द्विदण्डि प्रहरणं fighting with two sticks.
E.
द्वि, दण्ड a staff, इच् affix; also similar compounds, as द्विमुषलि, &c.

m. plu. (-शाः)
Twenty, two tens.
E.
द्वि, and दश ten.

f. (-म्नी)
A cow tied with two ropes.
E.
द्वि, and दामन् a rope.

m. (-हः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
द्वि two, and देह a body; having the head of an elephant, with the figure of a man.

f. (-त्या)
The constellation Viśākha.
E.
द्वि two, दैवत a deity, and क्यप् affix; INDRA and AGNI jointly presiding over the asterism.

ind.
Of two kinds, in two ways.
E.
द्वि two, धा aff.

n. (-णं)
Dividing into two parts, arranging in two ways, &c.
E.
द्विधा, and करण making.

m. (-तिः)
A crocodile.
E.
द्विधा of two sorts, गति going; amphibious.

mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु)
Having two natures, two roots, &c.
m. (-तुः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
द्वि two or double, धातु nature: see द्विदेह.

n. (-कं)
A nutmeg.
E.
द्विधा two sorts, and आत्मक being.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
To be written in two ways.
m. (-ख्यः)
The marshy date tree.
E.
द्विधा, and लेख्य to be written or described.

m. (-कः)
A circumcised man, one having no prepuce.
E.
द्वि two, नग्न naked, कन् added; exposed either by want of clothes or skin.

mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
Bought, &c. with two Niṣkas.
E.
द्वि, and निष्क a measure of value; also द्विनैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं).

m. (-पः)
1 An elephant.
2 A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
द्वि two, and प who drinks, the elephant imbibing fluids by his trunk, and thence conveying them into his mouth.

mf. (-पः-पं)
1 An island, any land surrounded by water; the word is hence applied to the seven grand divisions of the terrestrial world, each of these being separated from the next, by a peculiar and circumambient ocean: the seven Dvīpas, reckoning from the central one are, Jambu, Kuśa, Plakṣa, Śālmali, Krauncha, Śāka, and Puṣkara: the central Dvīpa, or the known continent, is again portioned into ten divisions, likewise termed Dvīpas: viz. Kuru, Candra, Varuṇa, Saumya, Nāga, Kumārikā, Gabhastimān, Tāmrāpūrna, Kaseru and Indra.
2 A tiger's skin.
E.
द्वि two, (on both sides,) and आप water, आ dropped, and इ made long.

n. (-थं)
A place where two roads meet.
E.
द्वि two, प्रथिन् a road.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Two-footed.
2 Having two parts.
3 Binomial.
m. (-दः)
A biped, including four genera, gods, demons, men, and birds.
E.
द्वि, and पद for पाद a foot.

f. (-शिः)
Either of the signs, Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, Virgo, and half of Sagittarius.
E.
द्विपद, and राशि a sign.

m. (-दः)
The elephant's temporal juice.
E.
द्विप, and मद the exudation.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Two-leaved, opposite-leaved.
E.
द्वि, and पर्ण a leaf.

n. (-त्त्वं)
The having of two feet, two parts, &c.
E.
द्विपाद्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्विपात्ता.

mfn. (-पाद् पती पत्)
Biped, two-footed.
E.
द्वि two, and पाद् for पाद a foot.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Bought, &c. with two quarters.
n. (-द्यं)
A double penalty, an amercement of twice the common amount.
E.
द्वि two, पाद a division, and यत् aff.

m. (-यी)
An elephant.
E.
द्वि two, and पायिन् who drinks: see द्विप.

m. (-ष्टः)
A proper name; also VASUDEVA.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bought, &c. with two Karṣas.
E.
द्वि, प्रति for कार्षापण, and ठन् added.

mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु)
Two-armed.
E.
द्वि, and बाहु an arm.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Two-armed.
2 An angle or the lines which form it.
E.
द्वि two, and भुज an arm.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made or consisting of two, (parts of any thing.)
E.
द्वि, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Having two mothers, born in two ways; it may be said of some of the deities, thus GAṆEŚA was the son of PĀRVATĪ, but not born in the usual way, being made of the scurf of her body: see द्वैमातुर.
E.
द्वि two, मातृ a mother, and ज born.

m. (-खः)
A serpent.
f. (-खः)
1 A small water jar.
2 A leech.
E.
द्वि, and मुख mouth; double-headed.

m. (-हिः)
A sort of serpent, (Amphisbœna.)
E.
द्वि two, मुख face, अहि a snake; the double-headed snake.

m. (-गः)
A sort of snake: see the last.
E.
द्विमुख as above, and उरग a snake.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
Two-headed.
E.
द्वि two, मूर्द्धन् the forehead, and यच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A bee: see द्विरेफ.

m. (-दः)
An elephant.
E.
द्वि two, and रद a tooth, having tusks and teeth.

m. (-कः)
A lion.
E.
द्विरद, and अन्तक destroyer.

n. (-नं)
Eating twice a day.
E.
द्वि, and अशन eating.

m. (-नः)
A snake in general.
E.
द्वि two, रसना the tongue; double or forky-tongued.

n. (-त्रं)
A period of two nights.
E.
द्वि, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

m. (-पः)
An elephant.
E.
द्विर् for द्वि two, आङ् prefixed to पा to drink, affix ड; drinking with the trunk and mouth: see द्विप.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Repeated, said twice.
2 Said or told in two ways.
E.
द्वि, and उक्त said.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Tautology, repetition.
2 Variety of narration, telling any thing in two ways.
3 (In Grammar,) Repetition of a syllable.
E.
द्वि, and उक्ति saying.

f. (-ढा)
A woman who has been twice married.
E.
द्वि two, उढ a married woman.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं)
1 Of two forms, having a different shape.
2 Spelled or written in two ways.
m. (-पः)
A word that may be correctly spelled in two ways.
2 Variety of interpretation or reading.
E.
द्वि, and रूप form.

m. (-फः)
A large black bee.
E.
द्वि two, रेफ the letter र; having two rs, in the most common name, भ्रमर, Bhramara.

n. (-न्दं)
A flight or swarm of bees.
E.
द्विरेफ, and वृन्द a number.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं)
Two years old, &c.
(-र्षा)
A cow two years old.
E.
द्वि two, वर्ष a year.

f. (-का)
A cow two years old.
E.
द्विवर्षा, and कन् added.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Two years old, two years standing, &c.
E.
द्वि two, वर्ष a year, ख affix; also with ठञ् affix द्विवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) when futurity is implied, the first vowel is usually changed, as द्वैवार्षिक.

f. (-का)
A swing, a swinging cot, a litter.
E.
द्वि two, वह to bear, affix ठक्; born usually by two men.

m. (-दः)
The name of a monkey, slain by RĀMA or VIṢṆU in that incarnation.

m. (-रिः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
द्विविद as above, अरि the foe.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Of two kinds, in two ways.
E.
द्वि, and विध sort.

f. (-रा)
A kind of carriage.

m. (-फः)
Any cloven-footed animal.
E.
द्वि, and शफ a hoof.

ind.
Two by two, respectively.
E.
द्वि two, and शस् aff.

m. (-कः)
A name of AGNI.
E.
द्वि two, शीर्ष a head, and कन् added.

mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं)
Bought with two winnowing baskets of anything.
E.
द्वि, and शूर्प्पं a basket; also with ठञ् द्विशौर्प्पिक, mfn. (-कः-की-कं).

m. (-ङ्गी)
A sort of fish, commonly called Marmaka.
E.
द्वि two, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (द्विषति) also (औ) औद्विष r. 2nd cl. (द्वेष्टि) plu. (द्विषन्ति)
To hate, to dislike, to be hostile or unfriendly.

mfn. (द्विट्)
Inimical, hostile.
m. (द्विट्)
An enemy.
E.
द्विष to hate, affix क्विप्; also with क affix द्विष. m. (-षः) or mfn. (-षः-षा-षं).

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
1 Hating or detesting, hostile.
2 Inimical, unfriendly.
m. (-न्)
An enemy.
E.
द्विष to hate, participal aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Vexing or harassing an enemy.
E.
द्विषत्, and ताप who afflicts, with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Punishing or annoying an enemy, revenging, retaliating.
E.
द्विष an enemy, तप to burn, affix खच्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Hated, disliked.
n. (-ष्टं)
Copper: see द्व्यष्ट.
E.
द्विष to hate, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Staying in two shapes or places, &c.
E.
द्वि two, and स्थ what is or abides.

m. (-हः)
A fortnight.
E.
द्वि twice, सप्त seven, and अह a day, twice seven days.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Consisting of two equal portions, &c.
E.
द्वि two, सम equal.

द्विसमत्रिभुजा^1
f. (-जा)
An isosceles triangle.
E.
द्वि, सम equal, त्रिभुजा triangle.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160511. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/259. note: triBujA is triangle. So 'BUjA' is misprint.

m. (-क्षः)
The great serpent, sovereign of the snake race, and the couch of VIṢṆU.
E.
द्विसहस्र two thousand, and अक्षि an eye; the two thousand-eyed.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Twice ploughed.
E.
द्वि twice, सीता a plough, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Two-breasted, two-uddered.
E.
द्धि, and स्तन breast.

m. (-हा)
An elephant.
E.
द्वि two, in two ways, with tusks and teeth, and हन् who kills.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Twice ploughed.
E.
द्वि two, हल a plough, affix यत्.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Two years old.
f. (-नी)
A cow two years old.
E.
द्वि two, हायन a year, affix अण् and ङीष्.

f. (-या)
A pregnant woman.
E.
द्वि two, हृदय a heart; having one of her own and one in the foetus.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Perceptible by two senses or forms, by sight and touch, &c.
E.
द्वि, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, ग्राह्य to be seized.

m. (-कः)
China camphor.
E.
द्वीप, and कर्पूर camphor.

m. (-वान्)
The ocean.
mf. (-वान्-वती)
A river.
f. (-वती)
The earth.
E.
